# Count the number of prizes (rows) for each beer within this period
prize_counts = df_filtered['beer name'].value_counts()

# Identify the beer with the maximum count
max_count = prize_counts.max()
most_decorated_beers = prize_counts[prize_counts == max_count].index.tolist()

# Check if 'maggs magnificent mild' is among the most decorated beers (there could be ties)
answer = 'maggs magnificent mild' in most_decorated_beers
